scripts.app-apk-emu-boot2run: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; EMU_BIN="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator"; if "$ADB" devices | grep -q 'emulator-5554'; then echo '✅ 模拟器 emulator-5554 已在运行，跳过启动'; else echo '▶ 启动模拟器 einz_emu（后台）…'; nohup "$EMU_BIN" -avd einz_emu >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo '▶ 等待 adb 设备上线…'; "$ADB" wait-for-device; echo '▶ 等待系统开机完成…'; until [ "$("$ADB" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done; echo '✅ 模拟器开机完成'; fi; printf '选择运行配置 [local / local-new / remote / remote-new]（回车默认 local）: '; if [ -n "$npm_config_mode" ]; then MODE="$npm_config_mode"; echo "$MODE"; else read -r MODE; fi; case "${MODE:-local}" in local) npm run app-apk-emu-run-local;; local-new) npm run app-apk-emu-run-local-new;; remote) npm run app-apk-emu-run-remote;; remote-new) npm run app-apk-emu-run-remote-new;; *) echo "未知配置: $MODE"; exit 1;; esac
scripts.app-apk-emu-run-local: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json
scripts.app-apk-emu-run-local-new: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter install -d emulator-5554; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json

scripts.app-apk-emu-run-remote-new: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; flutter install -d emulator-5554; flutter run -d emulator-5554
scripts.app-apk-build-release: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && flutter build apk --release --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER" && mkdir -p _release.gitomit && RELEASE="_release.gitomit/einz-app-android.${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.apk" && mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-emu-boot-usage:
echo 'Usage:
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot                       # 默认 config.default（ip16@26.3）
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot -- ip16@26.3          # 短名@系统版本（推荐，跨机器通用）
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot -- ip16pro@26.3       # iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.3
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot -- ip16@18.1          # iPhone 16 / iOS 18.1
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot -- "iPhone 16@26.3"   # 写机型全名也行
 npm run app-ios-emu-boot -- FF429526-A7EE-…    # 直接给 UDID
 EMU=ip16@18.1 npm run app-ios-emu-boot         # 用环境变量改默认

短名: ip16 / ip16plus / ip16pro / ip16pm（见 scripts/emuResolveIos.js）

跑 App（默认打当前已启动的那台，纯 booted）：
 npm run app-ios-emu-run-local
 EMU=ip16@26.3 npm run app-ios-emu-run-local   # 临时指定某台（flutter 会自己 boot 它）
'
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-local: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-local-new: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; xcrun simctl uninstall "${UDID}" cc.tic.einz.ios; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-remote: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-run-remote-new: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; xcrun simctl uninstall "${UDID}" cc.tic.einz.ios; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.app-ios-emu-refresh: echo '热重载（只刷新界面，不重置状态）'; kill -USR1 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
